event_name: Document 33 Date 11 June 2022 Time 21:25 2022 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 June 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 26 & 27) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Allegedly driving unnecessarily slowly during Qualifying
offence: Alleged breach of Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 44 (Lewis Hamilton), the driver of Car 4 (Lando Norris) and the team representatives, and examined video, radio communication and GPS evidence. Car 4 was following car 44 when the latter slowed in an effort to get car 4 to pass. The driver of car 4 decided not to pass and at the same time yellow flags were displayed at the next marshal post. Although car 4 was driven slowly, there was no potential danger to any other driver, this occurred on a straight section of road where visibility was not an issue, and there was room for the car behind (car 3) to pass if the driver of that car had wanted to. All three cars (cars 44, 4 and 3) were on "out" laps at the time.
rules_referenced: Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 4 Allegedly Driving Unnecessarily Slowly During Qualifying
